### Also

- **Local-first** — your library lives on your phone; optional end-to-end encrypted backup to your own iCloud / Google Drive.
- **Sources** — AniList · MyAnimeList · Bangumi · Kitsu · Annict · Simkl · Shikimori.
- **Languages** — English · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어.

<sub>iOS 16.4+ · Android 8.0+</sub>
